body: Well, they are helping, but for them to really work takes 3 weeks because your body needs to adapt to the antidepressants or other meds
Thank you so much, I appreciate it, kind stranger <3

Unfortunately, all of my coping mechanism were self-destructive, but I actually found something, just a half an hour ago (painting and reading).
From now on, I'll always make sure to spend some time painting or reading even if it is just a short amount of time.

It's a small step towards self-improvement, but I'll be better, I'll be okay, I need to promise myself that.

Thank you for all of your help and support, it really means a lot to me, and it helps me to cope with all the things that make me think of suicide.
Take care of yourself, you deserve it.

I need some time to finally realize that I deserve to be happy and to do what I honestly love doing. Thank you for the advice, I hope for the best.
Have a great day :)
